name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B
released_note: BF16 and NVFP4 repos created 2026-10-12; Unsloth GGUFs 2026-10-14.

architecture.layer_mix: Mamba-2 + Transformer hybrid MoE with a C-RADIO vision encoder; native multi-token prediction (MTP)

summary: NVIDIA's larger vision-language agent model: 120B total, 12B active, up to 1M context. NVIDIA publishes an NVFP4 checkpoint (75 GB) with a vLLM recipe written for one DGX Spark, plus a LiLiCorr speculative drafter. Ollama's tag is 80-90 GB.

practical_baseline.reason: No reported or measured run recorded yet.
